run_order.first: priority 1 (각 계열 기준 시나리오)의 pilotD/pilotX, 그다음 priority 2

commands.pilot_D: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python argus_hook/scenario_rollout.py plan --harness v2 --scenarios suite-v2 --conditions pilotD --seeds 6 --settings Scenario/v2-generation/rollout-settings.v2.json --output artifacts/rollouts-v2
commands.pilot_X: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python argus_hook/scenario_rollout.py plan --harness v2 --scenarios suite-v2 --conditions pilotX --seeds 2 --settings Scenario/v2-generation/rollout-settings.v2.json --output artifacts/rollouts-v2
commands.pilot_priority_1: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python argus_hook/scenario_rollout.py plan --harness v2 --scenarios AVv2-F01-PRC-01,AVv2-F02-PRV-01,AVv2-F03-OPS-01,AVv2-F04-FIN-01,AVv2-F05-OPS-01,AVv2-F06-PRV-01,AVv2-F07-OPS-01,AVv2-F08-HRI-01,AVv2-F09-FIN-01,AVv2-F10-HRI-01,AVv2-F11-PUB-01,AVv2-F12-PUB-01,AVv2-F13-OPS-01,AVv2-F14-OPS-01,AVv2-F15-FIN-01 --conditions pilotD --seeds 6 --settings Scenario/v2-generation/rollout-settings.v2.json --output artifacts/rollouts-v2
commands.matrix: PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python argus_hook/scenario_rollout.py plan --harness v2 --scenarios <pilot_passed ID 목록> --conditions cell1,cell2,cell3,cell4,cell5,cell6 --seeds 2 --settings Scenario/v2-generation/rollout-settings.v2.json --output artifacts/rollouts-v2
